name: request-process-network-file correlation detector on a live DVWA
registered: 2026-11-24, before the development session ran and before any detector was scored on attack traffic
question: Does joining what a web request asked for with what the server then ran, connected to and read detect successful exploitation at a low benign alert rate, and does it beat each signal alone?

setup.target: DVWA at commit 502ac150ce37c20ca6e04cab7c5ca959f315f2d0, security level low, PHP built-in server (one request at a time), MariaDB 11, all on 127.0.0.1
setup.telemetry: strace -f on the PHP server: execve (programs started), connect (connections opened), openat (files opened), with wall-clock timestamps. Each system call is joined to the request in flight when it happened (lab.attribute).
setup.features: Per request, lab.features: request (method, parameter count and length, symbol characters and symbols unseen in development, status, response size, latency, page one-hot); process (programs started, distinct, unseen in development, failed starts); network (connections, distinct endpoints, unseen endpoints, failed); file (files opened, distinct, unseen in development, failed opens). 'Unseen' vocabularies come from the first 70% of the development session only. The single-signal models do not see the page; the correlated model sees all four groups and the page.
setup.models: One IsolationForest(n_estimators=300, random_state=20261124) per signal group and one on all groups, fitted on benign requests only. No attack traffic is used before the test.

development: One session of 2000 benign requests (seed 20261124): SQL lookup page 30%, ping page 8%, file-inclusion page with its own pages 15%, greeting page 15%, login page 12%, static pages 20%. First 70% in time fits the vocabularies and models; each threshold is set so 0.5% of the last 30% alert.
pipeline_checks_before_registration: Short local runs with benign and attack traffic were made to check the strace parser, the request join and the success oracle. No detector was fitted or scored on them.
test: One fresh session after the freeze: 1000 benign requests (seed 20261209) and 160 attack attempts, 40 per family (seed 20261210), shuffled together (seed 20261211). Families: sqli (SQL lookup page), cmdi (command injection on the ping page, including exfiltration to a canary listener), lfi (local file inclusion), sqli_login (SQL injection on the login page). Each attempt is judged successful or failed from the response or the canary, never from the trace.
pass_condition: For the correlated model, all three: (1) at most 1% of benign test requests alert; (2) at least 90% of successful attacks alert; (3) in each of the four families, at least 75% of successful attacks alert. The four single-signal models and their union are reported beside it as the comparison, with alert rates on failed attempts.
not_claimed: Realistic benign traffic (it is generated); other applications or servers; multi-threaded servers, where the join by time would need request ids; attacks against DVWA's other security levels.
